This project is a modern **Next.js (App Router)** application built with **TypeScript**, using **Prisma** as the ORM and **pnpm** as the package manager. The architecture is organized around a route-based frontend (`app/`), reusable UI components (`components/`), and a server-side service layer (`lib/`).

**Main components:**

- **UI/Routes (`app/`)**: Includes public pages (home, login, register) and protected/authenticated dashboard routes with layouts. There are also API route handlers for authentication, user management, exam CRUD, and an AI integration.
- **Reusable Components (`components/`)**: Feature-specific React components such as `ExamCard`, `ExamForm`, `CalendarView`, `DashboardNavbar`, `AIAssistant`, and modal components. These are largely presentational and may contain client-side logic.
- **Service/Utility Layer (`lib/`)**: Central location for business logic and integrations including Prisma client initialization (`prisma.ts`), authentication (`auth.ts`), exam helpers (`examUtils.ts`), AI/Gemini integration (`gemini.ts`, `aiUtils.ts`), import/export utilities (`fileUtils.ts`, `ics.ts`), validation schemas (`schemas.ts`), and theming/themes.

**Business logic location:**
The core server-side business logic is found in **API routes** (`app/api`) and the **`lib/` utilities**. `lib` handles data manipulation, auth, external AI/calendar services, and database access. Domain logic also appears in a dedicated Prisma schema and migration files (`prisma/`). The `components/` folder contains UI-level logic and state, with user-facing interactions in the dashboard and exam features.

**Tests:** There are no test files or test directories (`.test`, `.spec`, `__tests__`) present in the structure.

**Tech stack:**

- Next.js (App Router) + React
- TypeScript
- Prisma (with migrations and seed)
- Tailwind CSS highly probable (PostCSS config, globals, styled components)
- pnpm (lockfile)
- Gemini/AI integration
- Husky (git hooks) + ESLint/Prettier for code quality
- ICS calendar file generation (export/import)
